The '''535th Assault Wing''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] unit in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] was the home base of this unit.
